prompt: @drafts i want to create a draft of Renter's agreement.

Please find below a draft for a Tenancy Agreement. Please note: This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. You should consult with a qualified legal professional for advice on your specific situation.

---

**TENANCY AGREEMENT**

This Tenancy Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "the Agreement") is made and entered into on this \[Day] day of \[Month], \[Year], at \[City, Province, Pakistan].

**BETWEEN:**

1.  **\[Landlord's Full Legal Name]**, Son/Daughter/Wife of \[Father's/Husband's Name], holding Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) No. \[Landlord's CNIC], residing at \[Landlord's Permanent Address], (hereinafter referred to as "the Landlord," which expression shall, where the context so admits, include his/her heirs, executors, administrators, and assigns) of the **FIRST PART**.

**AND**

2.  **\[Tenant's Full Legal Name]**, Son/Daughter/Wife of \[Father's/Husband's Name], holding Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) No. \[Tenant's CNIC], residing at \[Tenant's Permanent Address], (hereinafter referred to as "the Tenant," which expression shall, where the context so admits, include his/her heirs, executors, administrators, and assigns) of the **SECOND PART**.

**(The Landlord and the Tenant hereinafter collectively referred to as "the Parties" and individually as "a Party")**

**WHEREAS:**

A.  The Landlord is the lawful owner and is in peaceful possession of the property located at \[Complete Address of the Rental Property, including specific details like apartment number, floor, etc., and a description of electrical fittings and fixtures if desired] (hereinafter referred to as "the Demised Premises").

B.  The Tenant has approached the Landlord with a request to take the Demised Premises on rent for residential/commercial purposes, which the Landlord has agreed to on the terms and conditions hereinafter appearing.

**NOW, THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:**

**1. TERM OF TENANCY:**
    The tenancy shall commence from \[Start Date] and shall continue for a period of \[e.g., eleven (11) months / one (1) year], ending on \[End Date], unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.

**2. RENT:**
    a.  The monthly rent for the Demised Premises shall be PKR \[Amount in Figures]/- (Rupees \[Amount in Words] Only).
    b.  The rent shall be due and payable by the Tenant to the Landlord on or before the \[e.g., 5th] day of each calendar month.
    c.  The rent shall be paid by \[e.g., bank transfer to Account No. \______, Bank Name \______, Branch Name \______ / cash / cheque].

**3. ADVANCE RENT / SECURITY DEPOSIT:**
    a.  The Tenant shall pay to the Landlord a sum of PKR \[Amount in Figures]/- (Rupees \[Amount in Words] Only) as a non-adjustable advance rent for \[e.g., one (1) month] upon the execution of this Agreement.
    b.  The Tenant shall also pay to the Landlord a sum of PKR \[Amount in Figures]/- (Rupees \[Amount in Words] Only) as a refundable security deposit (hereinafter referred to as "the Security Deposit").
    c.  The Security Deposit shall be refunded to the Tenant upon peaceful vacation of the Demised Premises and after deducting any outstanding dues, damages (beyond normal wear and tear), or unpaid utility bills.

**4. RENT INCREASE:**
    The rent shall be increased by \[e.g., 10%] annually upon the renewal of this Agreement, or as mutually agreed upon by both Parties.

**5. UTILITIES AND CHARGES:**
    The Tenant shall be solely responsible for the timely payment of all utility bills, including but not limited to electricity, gas, water, and any other maintenance charges associated with the Demised Premises. The Tenant shall provide photocopies of paid utility bills to the Landlord upon request.

**6. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS:**
    a.  The Tenant shall keep and maintain the Demised Premises in good and tenantable condition, reasonable wear and tear excepted.
    b.  The Landlord shall be responsible for major structural repairs to the Demised Premises.
    c.  The Tenant shall be responsible for minor repairs and routine maintenance arising from their use of the property.

**7. PERMITTED USE OF PROPERTY:**
    a.  The Demised Premises shall be used strictly for \[e.g., residential purposes only / commercial purposes only for \_______ business].
    b.  The Tenant shall not sublet, assign, or part with possession of the Demised Premises or any part thereof without the prior written consent of the Landlord.

**8. PROHIBITION OF ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES:**
    The Tenant shall not use or permit the use of the Demised Premises for any illegal, immoral, or unlawful activities, nor for any purpose that causes nuisance or annoyance to the neighbors.

**9. PROPERTY INSPECTIONS:**
    The Landlord or his/her authorized representative shall have the right to enter and inspect the Demised Premises with a prior written notice of at least twenty-four (24) hours, at a reasonable time, to ensure compliance with the terms of this Agreement.

**10. ALTERATIONS TO PROPERTY:**
    The Tenant shall not make any additions, alterations, modifications, or structural changes to the Demised Premises without the prior written approval of the Landlord. Any approved alterations shall become the property of the Landlord upon termination of this Agreement, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

**11. HANDOVER OF POSSESSION:**
    Upon the termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Tenant shall peacefully vacate and hand over possession of the Demised Premises to the Landlord in the same good condition as received, reasonable wear and tear excepted, and after clearing all dues.

**12. EARLY TERMINATION:**
    a.  Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving \[e.g., one (1) month's] prior written notice to the other Party.
    b.  In case of early termination by the Tenant, the Landlord may forfeit the advance rent for the notice period.
    c.  The Landlord may terminate this Agreement immediately if the Tenant breaches any material term of this Agreement, including but not limited to failure to pay two consecutive months' rent.

**13. LEASE RENEWAL:**
    This Agreement may be renewed upon its expiry, subject to mutual consent of both Parties and renegotiation of terms, if any.

**14. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION:**
    a.  This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Pakistan, including the Transfer of Property Act 1882, the Contract Act 1872, and the relevant provincial rent restriction ordinances (e.g., The Punjab Rented Premises Act, 2009).
    b.  Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach, termination, or invalidity thereof, shall first be attempted to be resolved amicably through mutual discussions. If an amicable resolution is not reached, the dispute shall be resolved through \[e.g., arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration Act, 1940 / the competent courts in \_______ City, Pakistan].

**15. ENTIRE AGREEMENT:**
    This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the tenancy of the Demised Premises and supersedes all prior discussions, negotiations, and agreements, whether oral or written.

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF,** the Parties have executed this Agreement on the day, month, and year first above written.
